tasks.label: Auto-Setup Environment with pyenv
tasks.command: [ ! -d .venv ] && ( [ -f .python-version ] && pyenv install -s $(cat .python-version) ); python -m venv .venv && [ -f requirements.txt ] && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt || true

windows.command: if not exist .venv (if exist .python-version (for /f "delims=" %%i in (.python-version) do pyenv install -s %%i)) && if not exist .venv (python -m venv .venv) && (if exist requirements.txt (.venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt))
